narrative: Your loan application was carefully reviewed by our bank's machine learning model, which assesses credit risk based on patterns from past borrowers in 1970s Germany, and it determined there's an 84% probability that you represent a bad credit risk, leading to the denial of your request. At 63 years old, with a stable job as a skilled worker, over seven years at your current employment, owning your home, and no other installment plans or co-debtors, you have several positive aspects in your financial profile. However, the model focused on a few key factors that stood out as the strongest drivers pushing toward a higher risk prediction, with your checking account status having the most significant negative influence. To improve your chances next time, consider shortening the loan duration, building up your checking account balance, documenting any property assets more clearly, and perhaps starting with a smaller amount closer to typical approved levels. You might also work on updating your credit history with recent on-time payments. We encourage you to reapply after addressing these areas or explore smaller loans to demonstrate reliability.
